title: Package same-origin service and document local/operator setup
acceptance_criteria: Package Vite dist with compiled Node24, generated Prisma client and native runtime dependencies; add same-origin Vite development proxy and container/Compose setup without deployment.

Serve only dist and intended APIs with correct route/status/content types, no private data/root serving, allowlisted Host/origin and same-origin framing. Distinguish liveness and readiness; keep static/demo pages usable during DB outage.

Document exact setup/build/test, one-shot migrations, bootstrap, HTTPS, quotas/cleanup, log redaction, credential rotation, restore and rollback plus consent/retention operator review. No production db push/reset/auto-seed.
deliverables: Build/Compose and setup files, env example, README, and packaged runtime contract
